svg.title: AI tools across eight review stages
svg.desc: Static overview of the maintained RAISE-based map: 56 tool columns in source order, grouped into rule-based algorithms, unsupervised machine learning, supervised machine learning, and generative large language models. Eight review stages run down the side. Recommendation colours and diagonal split cells match the interactive map. White cells mean no use mapped. Tool names are omitted visually in this overview; each cell retains its tool, stage and recommendation in its accessible title. The neighbouring slide key explains the five colours.
